title: Egg Students who got the Scholarships

author: EGG Alumni Network
content: Congratulations, Htet Htet Aung!(Batch - 8) Warmest congratulations on receivng a Full Scholarship from Daughters Rising to pursue a Bachelor of Science in Environmental Science at Chaing Mai University.

title: EGG Students who got the Scholarships
summary: Receiving a Full Scholarship from Child's Dream Scholarship
author: EGG Alumni Network
content: We are truly proud of Nan Poe Ei Phyu and grateful for her dedication, hard work, and achievements throughout her educational journey. Receiving a Full Scholarship from Child's Dream is a remarkable achievement and a testament to her potential, and commitment to her education.

title: Congratulations Sayar Saw Thein Phod Awar 🎊
summary: The EggAlumni Network congratulates Sayar Saw Thein Phod Awar on being appointed as the President of Tounge La' Yat Community College (TLYCC) and expresses enthusiasm for his future leadership and guidance.
content:
We extend our sincere congratulations to Sayar Saw Thein Phod Awar on your appointment as President of Tounge La' Yat Community College (TLYCC).

We warmly welcome you to this role and look forward to your leadership in advancing academic excellence and institutional growth.
